text.description_html:
Fusion GRB-903-ORB, 8 Inch Oil Rubbed Bronze Door Pull

Made out of solid brass, the Textured Grab has an 8 inch center to center mounting and is finished in Oil Rubbed Bronze. A beautiful yet simple door pull, it is constructed out of solid brass. The textured beading adds the the overall luxury of the piece, transforming it from a classic design to a more modern one.

Specifications and Features of the Fusion GRB-903-ORB:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length: 8" center to center
  • Material: solid brass
  • Packaged Thru-Bolted Mounted: Pull bolts through the door.

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only One Left
